test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2022: Official Paper (Held On: 16 March, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
**Find the part of the given sentence that has an error in it. If there is no error, choose 'No error'.**

Vijay and Ajay is here to celebrate 7 years of their friendship.
solution:
The correct answer is **'Option 4'.** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• In the original sentence, there is a **subject-verb agreement error.**
 
• The** subject** "Vijay and Ajay" **is plural**, so the **verb should also be in the plural form** "are" instead of the singular form "is."
 
• **This ensures** proper subject-verb agreement.

Therefore, the **correct sentence** is: *'Vijay and Ajay **are here** to celebrate 7 years of their friendship'.*
